name: NetHack Learning Environment
description: A reinforcement learning benchmark based on the game NetHack, designed to test long-horizon planning, partial observability, sparse rewards, language understanding, and tool use in a roguelike environment.
evaluation_method: Average episodic return, score, dungeon depth progression, and task-specific success metrics across game episodes.
notes: A challenging benchmark due to combinatorial state space, sparse rewards, and the need to interpret textual game information.

scientists: Michał G. K. (NetHack Learning Environment authorship associated with the NLE paper)
